comments.author: Alexander Terp
comments.body: 2026-10-24: on main in c17ebbea. A post that leaves its wake to one a doorbell look has in hand reports that wake's held reason. A wake in hand for its very first look can still print woke; closing that would make the post wait for the look.

creator: Alexander Terp
description: Found 2026-10-24 under load: messaging::a_post_to_agents_in_panes_says_when_each_is_rung failed 2 of 12 CLI suite runs, its #8 saying 'woke: <p3> (p3, idle)' where p3's wake is held because its prompt holds a draft. Likely the hold guard added with b76817b6, which leaves a new wake to one in a doorbell look's hands and reports it as woken. Delivery is right; what the post prints is not. Being fixed with the in-hand case staged in a test.
title: A second post can say woke for a wake still held behind a draft
